```{r setup, include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r load_data}
data_dir <- here::here("seguimiento campo/data raw")

pre  <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "pre_clean.rds"))
long <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "long_clean.rds"))
post <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "post_clean.rds"))
```

---

## 1. Participant tracking table

```{r participante-table}
all_participants <- bind_rows(
  pre  |> select(email, nombre2, programa),
  long |> select(email, nombre2, programa),
  post |> select(email, nombre2)
) |>
  filter(!is.na(email)) |>
  group_by(email) |>
  summarise(
    nombre   = first(nombre2[!is.na(nombre2)]),
    programa = first(programa[!is.na(programa)]),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

long_summary <- long |>
  filter(!is.na(email)) |>
  group_by(email) |>
  summarise(
    flag_long  = n(),
    first_long = min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_long  = max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

tracker <- all_participants |>
  mutate(
    flag_pre  = email %in% pre$email[!is.na(pre$email)],
    flag_post = email %in% post$email[!is.na(post$email)]
  ) |>
  left_join(long_summary, by = "email") |>
  mutate(
    flag_long     = replace_na(flag_long, 0L),
    first_long    = if_else(flag_long == 0, NA, first_long),
    last_long     = if_else(flag_long == 0, NA, last_long),
    flag_inactivo = flag_long > 0 & (as.Date(last_long) <= Sys.Date() - 10)
  ) |>
  arrange(email) |>
  select(email, nombre, programa,
         flag_pre, flag_long, flag_post,
         flag_inactivo, first_long, last_long)

DT::datatable(
  tracker,
  colnames = c(
    "Email", "Name", "Program",
    "Pre", "Long (n)", "Post",
    "Inactive", "First measurement", "Last measurement"
  ),
  filter  = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 20)
)
```

---

## 2. Tracking table export (Excel)

```{r include=FALSE}
sheets <- list(
  "All"          = tracker,
  "No measurements" = filter(tracker, flag_long == 0), #hacen pretest, pero sin mediciones
  "No pretest"    = filter(tracker, !flag_pre), #hacen mediciones, falta pretest
  "Inactives"      = filter(tracker, flag_inactivo), #10 dias sin mediciones
  "Complete"      = filter(tracker, flag_pre & flag_long & !flag_inactivo),
  "No postest"    = filter(tracker, !flag_post)
)

writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, here::here("seguimiento campo", "tracker.xlsx"))
```

---

## 3. Profiles summary

```{r perfil-summary}
perfiles <- tracker |>
  mutate(perfil = case_when(
    flag_pre  & flag_long == 0 & !flag_post               ~ "Pretest only",
    !flag_pre & flag_long > 0                             ~ "Measurements only",
    flag_pre  & flag_long > 0  & !flag_post               ~ "No postest",
    flag_pre  & flag_long > 0  & flag_post                ~ "Complete",
    flag_long > 0 & as.Date(last_long) <= Sys.Date() - 10 ~ "Inactive (10d)",
    TRUE                                                  ~ "No activity"
  ))

perfiles |>
  count(perfil, name = "n_participantes") |>
  arrange(desc(n_participantes)) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Perfil", "N participantes"), align = c("l", "c"))

perfiles |>
  count(perfil, name = "n") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(perfil, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Profile summary", x = NULL, y = "N participants")
```

---

## 4. Profile summary by collaborator

```{r}
perfiles |>
  count(programa, perfil, name = "n_participantes") |>
  arrange(desc(n_participantes)) |>
  kable(col.names = c("Programa", "Perfil", "N participantes"), align = c("l", "l", "c"))

perfiles |>
  count(programa, perfil, name = "n") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(perfil, n), y = n, fill = perfil)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ programa) +
  labs(title = "Profile summary by program", x = NULL, y = "N participants")
```
